name: paragliding-forecasts-bulgaria
description: Local-first paragliding XC forecast decision-support tooling for Bulgaria.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @paragliding-forecasts/contracts && npm run build --workspace @paragliding-forecasts/api
scripts.start:api: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @paragliding-forecasts/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @paragliding-forecasts/contracts && npm run test --workspace @paragliding-forecasts/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @paragliding-forecasts/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @paragliding-forecasts/api
